title: Lost Mary BM600 Fizzy Cherry Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: The Fizzy Cherry Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pods blend bold, juicy Cherry notes with a sparkling, effervescent finish. The deep fruit flavour provides a solid base, while the subtle soda-like tang adds a vibrant, confectionery-inspired edge to the exhale. Each pack includes two 2ml pods prefilled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid, delivering up to 600 puffs* per pod depending on usage. Designed for a smooth mouth-to-lung (MTL) draw, they provide a satisfying experience with no need for refilling or coil changes. Made exclusively for the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these pods are quick and clean to install. Simply click a pod into the device and enjoy consistent flavour and vapour with every puff. *Puff counts are approximate and dependent on the length of each draw. Total puffs may vary.
